1775.de: A documentary film of Cubus Larvik's performance at the Vatiteater [Cotton Wool Theatre] located in the small town of Soodevahe in the autumn of 2011. In the evening sunlight, a group of people gathers around the Vatiteater building, which has no window panes and strips of cotton wool hanging from the ceiling. From the tall grass surrounding the building emerges Cubus Larvik, entirely wrapped in cotton wool with his face painted brown, who throws large plastic bundles ahead of himself and enters the building, where he improvises with various objects found there. Camera operator Sergei Trofimov. Editing by Timo Toots and Marika Agu. Sound by Karl Saks.

5463.d: Kohaspetsiifiline soundscape-installatsioon Endel Kõksi näitusele püüab ühendada Pallase-taustaga maalija loomingus olevaid kaugeid peegeldusi huvist elektroonika ja elektroonilise muusika ning väliseesti helilooja Udo Kasemetsa vastu (kes oli üks esimesi John Cage ideede järgijaid), Cage'i post-muusikalisi ideid seoses vaikusega ning Kõksi näituse toimumise fakti kontseptuaalselt vulgaarmaterialistlikust aspektist.
5463.de: A site-specific soundscape installation for Endel Kõks's exhibition attempts to combine the distant reflections, present in the work of this Pallas-trained painter, of an interest in electronics and electronic music and in the Estonian-born émigré composer Udo Kasemets (who was one of the first followers of John Cage's ideas), Cage's post-musical ideas connected with silence, and the fact of Kõks's exhibition taking place, from a conceptually vulgar-materialist perspective.

5498.de: Spatial installation. The space is divided in two by a curtain reaching from ceiling to floor, cut into strips in pastel tones. 5738.d: Värvifotol anonüümne tuba, mille otsaseinas läbikumavate sinakate klaasustega kapp, vasakul voodiots, millele asetatud riidepuudel triiksärgid, paremal tühi kirjutuslaud tooliga. Läbi kapiuste kumab kapisistuva, näoga vaataja poole pööratud alasti kunstniku figuur.
5738.de: In the colour photo an anonymous room, with a cabinet with translucent bluish glass panes on the end wall, on the left a bed end with dress shirts placed on hangers, on the right an empty writing desk with a chair. Through the cabinet doors the figure of a nude artist inside the cabinet, turned face towards the viewer, is glowing through.

5739.d: Värvifotol valge pind, millel vertikaalselt väljasirutatuna kaks päikesepõlenud kätt, foto alumises osas mehe rindkere, pea väljaspool kaadri ulatust. Käte vahel valgel pinnal afroameerika kirjaniku James Baldwin`i raamat „Keegi ei tea minu nime“, mille kaanel kirjaniku foto.
5739.de: In the colour photograph, a white surface on which two sunburnt hands are stretched out vertically, in the lower part of the photo a man's chest, his head outside the frame. Between the hands, on the white surface, the book "Keegi ei tea minu nime" ["Nobody Knows My Name"] by the African American writer James Baldwin, with the writer's photograph on the cover.

5740.d: Tagantvaates seisev musta riietunud kunstnik, kes nõjatub valgele metallist terrassipiirdele. Pilk suunatud ümberkaudsetele elamutele. Taamal sinise taeva taustal rohealad ja elamute katused. Mehe kõrval paremal põrandal lillepott kaktusega.
5740.de: Seen from behind, an artist dressed in black leaning against a white metal terrace railing. Gaze directed toward the surrounding buildings. Beyond, against a blue sky, green areas and roofs of buildings. Next to the man, on the right, a flowerpot with a cactus on the floor.

5741.d: Heledates värvides ruumis lebab küljel mustas riietuses kunstnik valge voodipesuga kaetud kušetil. Mehe silmad on suletud, suu paokil, pea toetub ühele käele, pealmine jalg sirutatult õhus. Teise käega hoiab külili asetsevast kaktuselise taime potist.
5741.de: In a room in light colours, an artist dressed in black lies on his side on a couch covered with white bedding. The man's eyes are closed, mouth ajar, head resting on one hand, the upper leg stretched out in the air. With the other hand he holds a pot with a cactus-like plant lying on its side.

5742.d: Kunstniku autoportree otsevaates. Mehe paremat silma katab tume ning vastupeegelduv päikeseprillidelt murtud klaas. Taustaks heledatest toonides kahhelkividest pind.
5742.de: Artist's self-portrait in full-face view. The man's right eye is covered by a dark, reflective broken lens from sunglasses. The background is a surface of light-toned tiles.

5743.d: Heledal kahhelplaatidest taustal kolmes korrapärases rivis kuivanud taime lehed. Esiplaanil paljad meesterahva labajalad ning kuivanud lehte hoidev käsi.
5743.de: On a light background of tiles, dried plant leaves in three regular rows. In the foreground, a man's bare feet and a hand holding a dried leaf.

5832.d: Videoinstallatsioon koosneb kahest seinaga eraldatud ruumist. Esimeses suurel ekraanil äreva helitaustaga videoprojektsioon, millel vahelduvad inimtühja äärelinna hämarad, ent realistlikud kaadrid. Teises öise äärelinna mängumakett kahe osaliselt tuledes kortermaja, valgustatud tänavate, vilkuva foori, tühja parkimisplatsi, pargiala ning kahe linnavaateid projitseeriva kuvariga, mida salvestavad maketi erinevatesse osadesse asetatud ning kordamööda sisse lülituvad veebikaamerad.
5832.de: The video installation consists of two rooms separated by a wall. In the first, on a large screen, a video projection with an anxious soundtrack, alternating dim but realistic shots of an empty suburb devoid of people. In the second, a night-time suburb play model with two partially lit apartment buildings, lit streets, a flashing traffic light, an empty parking lot, a park area, and two screens projecting city views, recorded by webcams placed in various parts of the model and switching on in turn.

6463.d: Rohelisel künkal avara maastiku taustal kolme ukseorvaga hele kabel, mille ees müürijupp. Vasakul hoonet varjamas raagus puutüvi, üksik puu hoonest paremal. Realistlik, pinnaline kujutamisviis.
6463.de: On a green hill against a background of open landscape, a light-coloured chapel with three door openings, in front of it a piece of wall. On the left a bare tree trunk partly obscuring the building, a single tree to the right of the building. Realistic, planar manner of depiction.

8122.d: Erksates toonides fotoliku täpsusega maalitud troopilise ürgmetsa laadne  varjulise veekogu kallas üksikute eredate päikeselaikudega langenud puudel ja rippuval taimestikul.
8122.de: A shore of a shady body of water resembling a tropical primeval forest, painted in vivid tones with photograph-like precision, with fallen trees and hanging vegetation lit by isolated bright patches of sunlight.

10511.d: Linnasiluetti kujutav minimalistlik metafüüsiline kompositsioon. Kolmeks horisontaalseks pinnaks jagatud maal, millest alumine osa valge, keskmine rohelisest siniseks üleminekutoonis, ülemine musta siluati kohal sinistes üleminekutoonides laotus.
10511.de: A minimalist metaphysical composition depicting a city silhouette. The painting is divided into three horizontal planes, of which the lower part is white, the middle part in a transitional tone from green to blue, and the upper part, above a black silhouette, spreads out in transitional shades of blue.

10555.d: Sürreaalne kompositsioon lendavate lindude ning abstraheeritud pilvede ja maastikuga.
10555.de: Surreal composition with flying birds and abstracted clouds and landscape.

10556.d: Geomeetrilisteks pindadeks jaotatud kompositsioon abstraheeritud vormide ja sürreaalsete olenditega.
10556.de: A composition divided into geometric planes with abstracted forms and surreal beings.

10600.d: Hallil taustal kompositsioon joova mehe taha kallutatud täisfiguuriga. Mehel paremas käes plastikupudel, jalas heledad tossud ja seljas tumedad dressid. Figuur põlvedest lõuani viimistletud valgele krundile söetehnikas.
10600.de: On a grey background a composition with the full figure of a drinking man leaning back. In the man's right hand a plastic bottle, on his feet light-coloured sneakers and dark tracksuit. The figure from the knees to the chin executed in charcoal technique on a finished white ground.

10690.d: Heledates toonides stseen käest kinni hoidvate lasteriviga. Keskmine laps seisab ühe jalaga ühel ja teise jalaga teisel pool väikest oja. Esiplaanil ja vasakus servas hall mummude ja kriipsudega pind, taustal metsaviirg ja taevas.
10690.de: A scene in light tones of a row of children holding hands. The middle child stands with one foot on one side and the other foot on the other side of a small stream. In the foreground and on the left margin a grey surface with dots and dashes, in the background a strip of forest and sky.

10691.d: Abstraktne hallides toonides kompositsioon, mida ilmestavad tumerohelised värvilaigud. Üle terve pildi pinna väiksemaid punaseid, rohelisi ja siniseid laike ning korrapärases paigutuses valged mummud.
10691.de: An abstract composition in grey tones, enlivened by dark green patches of colour. Smaller red, green and blue patches are scattered over the entire surface of the picture, along with white dots arranged in a regular pattern.

10721.d: Maalipind jaotunud kolmeks vertikaalseks osaks. Keskmisest tumedast pinnast paremal heleda, pilvise taeva taustal fotorealistlikult antud maastikuvaade kaljul asuva majakaga. Vasakul merevaade.
10721.de: The painted surface is divided into three vertical parts. To the right of the dark middle surface, against a light, cloudy sky, a photorealistically rendered landscape view with a lighthouse on a cliff. On the left a sea view.

10728.d: Maal jaotatud erinevas laadis antud pildipindadeks, vasakul keskel ja all ääres hüperrealistlikud motiivid.  Paremal kollane ristkülik, mis jätkub teose külgedel. Keskel eskiislikud ruumilahendused.
10728.de: The painting divided into picture surfaces rendered in different styles, hyperrealistic motifs at the center left and along the bottom edge. On the right a yellow rectangle, which continues on the sides of the work. In the center, sketch-like spatial solutions.

10732.d: Maal on jaotatud erinevas laadis pildipindadeks, domineerib kastanpruun värvipind. Ülemises vasakus ja paremas nurgas hall ja valge pind, paremal mõned kuuseladvad. Keskmist osa läbib valge-pruuni-valge trikoloor koos abstraktsete mustade ja pruunide elementidega ning miniatuurse figuuriga valgel pinnal.
10732.de: The painting is divided into picture surfaces of different character, dominated by a chestnut-brown colour field. In the upper left and right corners a grey and white surface, on the right a few spruce tops. The middle section is crossed by a white-brown-white tricolour with abstract black and brown elements and a miniature figure on a white surface.

10739.d: Tumedas koloriidis, visandlikku ja fotorealistlikku maalilaadi sünteesivad värvipinnad, milledel aimatavad erinevas perspektiivis kujutatud ruumivaated. Vasakul nurgas paistmas puude ladvad.
10739.de: In a dark colour scheme, colour surfaces synthesising a sketch-like and photorealistic painting style, on which spatial views depicted in different perspectives can be discerned. In the left corner the tops of trees are visible.

10751.d: Kahest maalist, kahest külgpannoost ning päikesest koosnev installatsioon. Kaido Ole "Kenotaafi" maalil on kujutatud murukatte ja paksu mullakihi all lamavat meest külgvaates. Maali peale on asetatud Andres Toltsi teos "Maamõõtjad" (M 7579) ning omakorda selle kohal on päike. Kahelt poolt ümbritsevad kompositsiooni külgpannood, vasakpoolsel kujutatud "A" täht, parempoolsel "T".
10751.de: An installation consisting of two paintings, two side panels and a sun. Kaido Ole's painting "Kenotaaf" depicts a man lying in profile under a grass cover and a thick layer of soil. Placed on top of the painting is Andres Tolts's work "Maamõõtjad" (M 7579), and above that in turn is the sun. The composition is flanked on both sides by side panels, the left one depicting the letter "A", the right one "T".

10755.d: Pikemal küljel seisev ruumiline valge kuusnurkne objekt, mille sees on erineval tasandil kuus väiksemat kuusnurka.
10755.de: A three-dimensional white hexagonal object standing on its longer side, inside which are six smaller hexagons at different levels.

10756.d: Üle terve maalipinna (välja arvatud servad) kulgeb ruudustik domineerivalt lillades toonides, siin-seal leidub ka kolleseid, rohelisi ja siniseid aktsente.
10756.de: Across the entire painted surface (except the edges) runs a grid predominantly in purple tones, here and there also yellow, green and blue accents.

10861.d: Heleroosal taustal neli korduvat geomeetrilist vormi, mis on maalitud halli gradiendi pindadena.
10861.de: On a light pink background four repeating geometric forms, painted as grey gradient surfaces.

10866.d: Õrnal hallikal-rohekal taustal kujutatud gradiendis lehvikut meenutavat vormi.
10866.de: Against a delicate grayish-greenish background a fan-like form depicted in gradient.

10879.de: A symmetrical beige shape on a pale pink background.

10893.d: Heleroosal taustal kaheksa figuuri öökimas verd. Kompositsiooni paremas servas fragmenteeritud kehaosad nagu käsi ja rind, mille ümber seisavad omakorda kuus väiksemat sinist figuuri..
10893.de: Against a light pink background, eight figures spitting blood. In the right edge of the composition fragmented body parts such as a hand and a breast, around which in turn stand six smaller blue figures.

10894.d: Lillakas-roosakal taustal hõljub õhus naisfiguur. Akt on kujutatud mitme jäsemega, rõhutades figuuri liikumist õhus. Karikatuurse silma must iiris on tilga-kujuline.
10894.de: A female figure hovers in the air against a purplish-pink background. The nude is depicted with several limbs, emphasising the figure's movement in the air. The black iris of the caricatured eye is drop-shaped.

12357.d: Üks kuueteistkümnest erineva välimusega ja erinevas mõõdus nukupeast. Pead on suurendatud portreed autori poolt leitud nukkude järgi, algselt modelleeritud ja seejärel vormi valatud; plastmaterjal on kaetud betoonikihiga.
12357.de: One of sixteen doll heads of different appearance and different size. The heads are enlarged portraits based on dolls found by the artist, originally modelled and then cast in a mould; the plastic material is covered with a layer of concrete.

12738.dm: aeg/ kestus: 44.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 11.0 minut
12738.d: Videoinstallatsioon "Kuuldud jutt" koosneb kaheksast videost, mis jooksevad kaheksal lameekraanil, ning baldahhiinvoodist. Voodit kattev madrats on kaetud lilla aluslinaga. Madratsil on kaheksa erivärvilist (sidrunikollane, soe kollane, oranž, punane, roheline, helesinine, tumesinine, lilla) puuvillase padjapüüriga patja ja neli erivärvilist (sidrunikollane,  oranž, roheline, helesinine) puuvillase tekikoti sees olevat tekki. Kaheksa patja on asetatud ringikujuliselt voodi keskele. Iga padja peale on asetatud paar kõrvaklappe, mis kannab vastava video numbrit, millega ta on ühendatud. Kaheksa lameekraani on asetatud baldahiinvoodi ülemiste talade külge. Videod mängivad ekraanidel katkematult
12738.de: The video installation "Kuuldud jutt" consists of eight videos running on eight flat screens, and a canopy bed. The mattress covering the bed is covered with a purple bottom sheet. On the mattress there are eight cotton pillowcase-covered pillows of different colours (lemon yellow, warm yellow, orange, red, green, light blue, dark blue, purple) and four duvets of different colours (lemon yellow, orange, green, light blue) inside cotton duvet covers. The eight pillows are placed in a circular arrangement in the middle of the bed. On each pillow a pair of headphones is placed, bearing the number of the corresponding video to which it is connected. The eight flat screens are attached to the upper beams of the canopy bed. The videos play continuously on the screens

12739.d: Interaktiivne installatsioon. Sinise, kollase ja roosa tekstiiliga kaetud hiiglaslik mobiiltelefon. Esiküljel arvutiekraan, millel kuvatud roosal taustal valge kiri "Astrid". Telefoni klahvid lamineeritud plastikuga. Telefoniga saab klahvidele vajutades helistada riigisisestele telefoninumbritele. Vastuvõtja hääl kostub sisseehitatud kõlaris. Valitud number kuvatakse arvutiekraanil.
12739.de: Interactive installation. A giant mobile phone covered with blue, yellow and pink textile. On the front side a computer screen displaying white text "Astrid" on a pink background. The phone's keys are laminated with plastic. By pressing the keys one can call domestic telephone numbers with the phone. The receiver's voice can be heard through a built-in speaker. The dialled number is displayed on the computer screen.

12748.dm: pikkus: 6.0 m (varieeruv); kõrgus: 3.5 m (varieeruv); laius: 9.0 m (varieeruv)
12748.d: Riigiarhivaari tööruume markeeriv ruumiinstallatsioon koosneb suuremast ruumist ja selle sisse ehitatud väiksemast ruumist, mida lahutavad vaheseinad ja avatud uks. Suuremas ruumis katkematus reas seinal raamitud ja klaasitud joonistused, millel kujutatud realistlikus laadis väikeseid lindusid, väiksemas ruumis uute tulmete hoidla maast laeni ulatuvate raamaturiiulitega, mis täidetud hooletult hallide purunevate vanapaberi massist raamatukujuliste objektidega, riiulite taga eraldatud nurgas arhivaari töölaud J. S. Bachi teost mängiva raadio, lauale asetatud prillide ja poolelijäänud joonistustega lindudest arhiivblankettidel.
12748.de: The spatial installation marking the working rooms of the State Archivist consists of a larger room and a smaller room built inside it, separated by partition walls and an open door. In the larger room, along the wall in an unbroken row, are framed and glazed drawings depicting small birds in a realistic style; in the smaller room is a repository of new accessions with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled carelessly with book-shaped objects made from a mass of grey, crumbling waste paper; behind the shelves, in a separate corner, is the archivist's desk with a radio playing a work by J. S. Bach, glasses placed on the desk, and unfinished drawings of birds on archive forms.

12749.d: Kohaspetsiifiline fotoinstallatsioon koosneb tühja valgustatud näitusesaali seina kujutavast fotost ja fotol näha oleva pika juhtmega lambist, mis on installeeritud foto kohale täpselt fotol kujutatud viisil, võttes aluseks Kumu kunstimuuseumi modernistliku, valgete seinte ja puitparketiga ekspositsioonipinna.
12749.de: The site-specific photo installation consists of a photograph depicting the wall of an empty, illuminated exhibition hall and a lamp with a long cord visible in the photograph, installed above the photograph exactly in the manner depicted in the photograph, based on the modernist exhibition space of the Kumu Art Museum with its white walls and wooden parquet floor.

12756.dm: sügavus: 7.0 cm (gabariit); laius: 18.6 cm; kõrgus: 19.8 cm
12756.d: Miniatuurne puitalusel installatsioon, mille ühes nurgas üksteise suhtes täisnurkselt kaks peeglit ja nende vahel kullast maja neljandik, mis peegeldustega koos moodustab terviku.
12756.de: A miniature installation on a wooden base, in one corner of which two mirrors are placed at right angles to each other, and between them a quarter of a golden house, which together with the reflections forms a whole.

12822.d: Hilissuvine äärelinnavaade, mille tagaplaanil suur roostetav tööstushoone ja kaks paneelmaja, esiplaanil päevalillepõld, mille servades õunapuudega ääristatud niit ja madalam hoonetegrupp. Päevalillepõllu ja niidu vahelisel alal lambad ja karjused hobustel, niidu kõrges rohus täisvarustuses sõjaväelased. Värvigamma hilissuviselt soe, taustal kollakas õhtune taevas. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
12822.de: A late-summer suburban view, in the background a large rusting industrial building and two panel buildings, in the foreground a sunflower field, bordered by a meadow lined with apple trees and a lower group of buildings. In the area between the sunflower field and the meadow, sheep and shepherds on horses; in the tall grass of the meadow, fully equipped soldiers. A late-summer warm colour scheme, in the background a yellowish evening sky. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition at the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe. The series presents a fragment of a Lasnamäe district, whose landscape has been turned into a productive and locally functioning macro-neighbourhood.

12823.d: Hilissügisene linnavaade, mille keskmes suur roostetav tööstushoone, selle ümber raagus puid ja madalamaid hooneid ning ees niit, mille kõrges rohus kollane ekskavaator ja rühm täisvarustuses sõjaväelasi. Värvigamma hilissügiseselt soe, taevas ähvardavalt tume ja pilvine. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal, visandades virtuaalreaalsuse vahendusel nõukogude utoopiat kandva linnajao tulevikku. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
12823.de: A late-autumn cityscape, at the centre of which a large rusting industrial building, around it bare trees and lower buildings, and in front a meadow, in whose tall grass a yellow excavator and a group of fully equipped soldiers. The colour range is late-autumn warm, the sky menacingly dark and cloudy. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition of the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe, sketching through virtual reality the future of a district that carries a Soviet utopia. The series presents a fragment of a Lasnamäe quarter, whose landscape has been transformed into a productive and locally functioning macro-district.

12824.d: Varakevadine pommiplahvatuste ja tulekolletega linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul tuulegeneraatorid, paneelmajade grupp ja plahvatusest tekkinud tossupilv, paremal kõrgepingeliini kandev torn ja paneelmaja. Esiplaanil raagus puudega ääristatud tühermaa metallist mahutite, lennukirusude ja seakarjaga puude all. Värvigamma pruunjas, taustal poolpilvine õhtune taevas. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
12824.de: An early-spring cityscape with bomb explosions and fires, in the background on the left wind generators, a group of panel buildings and a cloud of smoke from an explosion, on the right a tower carrying a high-voltage line and a panel building. In the foreground a wasteland lined with bare trees, with metal containers, aircraft wreckage and a herd of pigs under the trees. Brownish colour scheme, in the background a partly cloudy evening sky. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition at the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe. The series presents a fragment of a Lasnamäe district, whose landscape has been turned into a productive and locally functioning macro-neighbourhood.

12825.d: Talvine mereäärne linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul kõrgepingeliini kandev torn koos madala tootmishoonestusega, esiplaanil  jäätunud meri ja sellesse saetud augu ääres jääl mootorsaag ja võrguga toimetav kalamees. Värvigamma talviselt-päikseliselt hele, taustal sinine rünkpilvedega taevas. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
12825.de: A winter seaside townscape, in the background on the left a pylon carrying a high-voltage power line together with low industrial buildings, in the foreground a frozen sea and, by a hole sawn into it, on the ice, a chainsaw and a fisherman working with a net. The colour scheme is winterly-sunnily bright, in the background a blue sky with cumulus clouds. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition at the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe. The series presents a fragment of one Lasnamäe district, whose landscape has been transformed into a productive and locally functioning macro-neighbourhood.

12826.d: Hilissügisene äärelinnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul kauge linn koos püramiidiga, paremal maanteesild, esiplaanil raagus puudega ääristatud karjamaa lehmade, šoti mägiveiste ja lammastega ning grupi täisvarustuses sõjaväelastega maanteesilla all paremal. Värvigamma pruunikas-hall, taustal õhtune poolpilvine taevas. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
12826.de: A late-autumn suburban view, with a distant city and a pyramid at the back left, a motorway bridge on the right, and in the foreground a pasture lined with bare trees with cows, Scottish highland cattle and sheep, and a group of fully equipped soldiers under the motorway bridge at the front right. The colour scheme is brownish-grey, with an evening, partly cloudy sky in the background. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a pyramid car park built from rock waste.

12827.d: Öine veeäärne linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul tuledes hooned ja püramiid, esiplaanil vasakul vesi ja paremal rongijaam raudteesõlmega. Värvigamma öiselt tume. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
12827.de: A night-time waterside city view, with lit buildings and a pyramid in the background on the left, water in the foreground on the left and a railway station with a rail junction on the right. The colour scheme is dark, nocturnal. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a parking-city built of pyramids made from stone waste.

12828.d: Hilissügisene linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil paremal kõrge kaasaegne linnak koos neljarealise autoteega, esiplaanil vasakul hooneosa rõduga, millel seisavad kaks inimest, taustal püramiidide parklinnak, mille horisontaalsetel pindadel väiksemaid hooneid, raagus puid ja inimesi. Värvigamma valkjas-hall, taustal hallide pilveräbalatega hele taevas. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
12828.de: A late-autumn cityscape, in the background on the right a tall modern complex with a four-lane road, in the foreground on the left part of a building with a balcony on which two people stand, in the background a pyramid-shaped parking complex, on the horizontal surfaces of which smaller buildings, bare trees and people. The colour scheme is whitish-grey, in the background a light sky with grey shreds of cloud. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposit area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a parking complex made of pyramids built from stone waste.

12829.d: Hilissügisene linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil valged kõrged paneelelamud, esiplaanil vasakul püramiidide parklinnak, mille erinevatel horisontaalsetel pindadel raagus puid ja inimgruppe, esiplaanil paremal paneelmajade vahelt vooklev maanteesild koos teedesõlmega. Värvigamma valkjas helehall, taustal sudusse mähkuv taevas. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
12829.de: A late-autumn cityscape with tall white panel apartment buildings in the background, a pyramid-shaped car park at the front left with bare trees and groups of people on its various horizontal surfaces, and at the front right a winding motorway bridge with an interchange running between the panel buildings. The colour scheme is whitish light grey, with the sky in the background wrapped in haze. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a pyramid car park built from rock waste.

12830.d: Audioraamatu peatükk Holger Kaintsi raamatust „Lennukivaatleja“ (2009), milles kirjeldatud taasiseseisvumisjärgsest ühiskonnast võõrandunud erakliku minajutustaja tegevust Soodevahe aedlinnakus, kus ta veedab aega Tallinna lennuvälja lennuliiklust jälgides ning sellega haakuvaid vandenõuteooriaid arendades. Taustaks aialappide tehasetöölistele väljajagamise ja Soodevahe aianduskooperatiivi tekkimise lugu. Audioraamatut loeb Rasmus Kaljujärv. Salvestus Timo Toots.
12830.de: An audiobook chapter from Holger Kaints' book "Lennukivaatleja" (2009), which describes the actions of a reclusive first-person narrator, alienated from post-independence society, in the Soodevahe garden town, where he spends his time watching the air traffic at Tallinn Airport and developing related conspiracy theories. The background is the story of the distribution of garden plots to factory workers and the emergence of the Soodevahe gardening cooperative. The audiobook is read by Rasmus Kaljujärv. Recording by Timo Toots.

12834.d: Pehmes köites värvitrükis raamat, mille lehekülgede formaat on vahelduv. Raamatus on värvitrükis illustratsioonid erinevatest teostest, nende vahel helesinisele paberile trükitud tekstiväljavõtted erinevatest ingliskeelsetest teostest. Trükise ümber on must-valge ümbris, millel kujutatud kaht kivist skulptuuri (religioosne stseen - Maarja kuulutus).
12834.de: A softcover book printed in colour, with a varying page format. The book contains colour-printed illustrations of various works, interspersed with text excerpts from various English-language works printed on light blue paper. The publication is wrapped in a black-and-white cover depicting two stone sculptures (a religious scene - the Annunciation).

12836.d: Heliinstallatsioon koosneb viiest torpeedokujulisest objektist, mis asetsevad metallist statiividel. Torpeedod installeeritakse koos ventilatsioonisüsteemiga, mis asub objektide taga. Torpeedokujulised objektid tekitavad vastavalt tiivikute pöörlemiskiirusele impulssheli. Pöörlemiskiirust muudetakse ventilatsioonitorus asuva reguleerimisklapiga.
12836.de: The sound installation consists of five torpedo-shaped objects placed on metal stands. The torpedoes are installed together with a ventilation system located behind the objects. The torpedo-shaped objects produce a pulsating sound according to the rotation speed of the impellers. The rotation speed is adjusted with a regulating valve located in the ventilation duct.

12968.de: Spatial installation. The space is divided in two by a curtain cut into strips in pastel tones, reaching from ceiling to floor. On the floor lie various objects repainted in similar tones - textiles, ready-made objects, canvas screens stretched on stretcher frames. The floor is covered with a white cover.

Ruumis on linnaheliga helitaust.  Lisaks kahepoolne A2 formaadis plakat või raamitud fotoprint.

The room has a soundscape of city noise. In addition, a double-sided A2 format poster or a framed photo print.

60045.d: Liina Siib, A Woman Takes Little Space. 2011. The Estonian Pavilion at the 54th Venice biennale. Liina Siib ’s project A Woman Takes Little Space represented Estonia at the 54th International Art Exhibition, La Biennale di Venezia (04.06.–27.11.2011). The exhibition connected room installations in an apartment-like, (un)homely environment. In her photo, video and site-specific room installations, the artist explored various topics, ranging from femininity and social space to different representations of women in contemporary society, as well as ‘feminine’ jobs and prostitution. The exhibition took place at Palazzo Malipiero. The title work of the exhibition, the photography series A Woman Takes Little Space (2007–2011), captures women of different ages and social status at their places of work. The title’s slightly awkward humour and reverse accusation highlights the exhibition’s most obvious level, one that arises from the politics of contemporary life. The series is inspired by a claim made in an opinion column on gender equality that appeared in the Estonian media a few years ago stating that women need less space for their everyday work (and less pay) than men. 60046.d: Dénes Farkas with his exhibition Evident in Advance represented Estonia at the 55th Venice Biennale (01.06 – 24.11.2013). The project was made in collaboration with the curator Adam Budak , the Berlin-based architectural bureau Studio Miessen and the London-based graphic designer Zak Group . Evident in Advance was a continuation of Farkas’s post-conceptual photo-based oeuvre that creates a deeply contemplative space using a minimalist approach. 60064.d: The exhibition series “Drama is in your head I-III” (2012-2013) reflected on people’s (and the artist’s) personal doubts about their surroundings. This series can be seen as the artist’s method to deal with conflicts in everyday life and potential dramatic scenarios. For example, “Drama is in your head II” (2013) presented a plaster cast army of child-size ghosts, which simultaneously referred to fears from childhood but also to the anxiety of adulthood, encompassing a moment after Karlson’s 30th birthday.

60070.d: Kaido Ole’s mural titled New Model appeared on the wall of EKKM in 2010 in connection with the Next to Nothing exhibition, and soon a plan was hatched to include the work in the collection. Artist Kaido Ole, understanding his limited choices – to have the work survive it would have to belong to the collection, otherwise it would just be destroyed – agreed to have EKKM store the work of art unconditionally until 7 o’clock on 23 July 2013, when three years will have passed since it was displayed to the public. Thereafter, the agreement will be reviewed and a decision made whether to renew it or not.

60074.d: Since OÜ Visible Solutions moved to KUMU for the summer to develop new products, they donated one of last year’s prototypes – Clarity: an exterior area of an interior space – to CAME. To quote the KUMU press release, “OÜ Visible Solutions is a work of art/enterprise, which operates on the edge between the economic and artistic fields, by examining them as ideologized spaces and language environments; and if one is located between them, one can interpret phenomena and concepts from one to the other. The group deals with the main principles of modern economic space, by using creative industries and processes based thereon as the primary analytical material. The group examines the new global symptoms of all-inclusive neo-liberal economic logic.”
